method: Historical reconciliation across the six living QA scenario areas. This file is preserved for traceability and is not accepted as the qa-execution experiential-lens re-walk.

rewalks.driver: agent-browser native pointer clicks for every player action
rewalks.environment: file://, offline, 1280x720, isolated fresh session, seed 1 before Jogar
rewalks.endpoint: campaign_complete; physical to supernatural; destroy; H4/H7/H8 dead; validate ok

lenses.CAM: 117 accepted actions reached the destroy terminal after both routes and a complete medallion.
lenses.ENC: The journey crossed sacrifice_choice and three recorded death consequences before the terminal choice.
lenses.FOR: The campaign continued with five living heroes; separate native-pointer reserve probes corroborate automatic groups with one and two living heroes, and the total-loss journey records three.
lenses.ACC: The pointer path remained reachable through the inspected portrait-overlap case by naturally moving outside the sheet and back to a visible portrait point; validate stayed clean. The final native-keyboard supplement separately confirms irreversible sacrifice, held-Enter protection, Escape focus return and immediate reduced-motion absence.
lenses.LOC: The original package ran directly from file:// with offline mode enabled.
lenses.ART: The terminal and death presentation remained functionally readable; the current 252-pair visual contract passes. Editorial, cultural and final-art acceptance remain human-only.

rewalks.driver: Playwright MCP native Tab, arrows, Enter, Space and Escape; native Chrome zoom 125%
rewalks.environment: file://, offline, 1536x864 effective CSS pixels, DPR 1.25, isolated fresh profile, seed 20260831 before Jogar
rewalks.endpoint: campaign_complete; physical to supernatural; reunite; eight living heroes; no memorial; restart and reload both returned ready

lenses.CAM: 106 accepted campaign actions reached reunion after Igreja, Parque, Vilarejo and Conselho; the terminal stayed stable during roster consultation.
lenses.ENC: All encounters were completed through public controls with eight heroes alive and no memorial path.
lenses.FOR: All eight hero sheets were reached by arrow navigation without changing the campaign sequence; H1/H2/H3 were selected with Space.
lenses.ACC: Native keyboard, focus return, modal containment, Shift+Tab, Escape and native 125% zoom were observed with zero horizontal overflow.
lenses.LOC: The local package made zero HTTP(S) requests; Jogar novamente and literal reload returned clean opening state with null seed and no inherited seen text.
lenses.ART: Accepted native framebuffer captures preserve readable formation, routes, Council and completed state. Human VoiceOver, editorial, cultural and final-art judgments remain unperformed.
